name: ephemeral_kinematic_cohesion
label: Ephemeral Kinematic Cohesion
poeticVision: Imagine running across a crumbling memory-world, the Silence's hunters closing in. Suddenly, a section of the floor beneath you inexplicably loses friction, sending you sliding into danger. Or a jump you've perfectly timed before now falls short, as your body's perceived mass momentarily doubles, a phantom weight of forgotten identity dragging you down. The world itself struggles to remember its own rules, making every step a gamble against the unraveling fabric of reality, reflecting Lyra's own fracturing self. The player feels a profound, existential uncertainty with every movement, as if the very ground beneath their feet is losing its memory of how to be solid.
usage: Attach this script to Lyra's CharacterBody3D node. The 'identity_coherence' parameter should be dynamically updated by other game logic (e.g., when Lyra loses a memory fragment, decrease 'identity_coherence'). As 'identity_coherence' decreases, Lyra's movement physics (gravity, friction, bounce) will become increasingly unstable and unpredictable, reflecting her fracturing identity. 'fluctuation_strength' controls the maximum intensity of these effects, 'base_gravity_scale', 'base_friction', and 'base_bounce' define Lyra's stable physics properties, and 'fluctuation_speed' determines how rapidly these parameters change over time. This creates a constant sense of physical uncertainty and danger.

parameters.name: identity_coherence
parameters.description: Current identity coherence (0.0-1.0). Lower values increase physics instability.

parameters.name: fluctuation_strength
parameters.description: Maximum strength of physics fluctuations when identity coherence is low.

parameters.name: base_gravity_scale
parameters.description: The base gravity scale for Lyra when identity is stable. This value is initialized from the CharacterBody3D's gravity_scale property.

parameters.name: base_friction
parameters.description: The base friction for Lyra's physics material when identity is stable. This value is initialized from the CharacterBody3D's physics_material_override.

parameters.name: base_bounce
parameters.description: The base bounce for Lyra's physics material when identity is stable. This value is initialized from the CharacterBody3D's physics_material_override.

parameters.name: fluctuation_speed
parameters.description: Speed at which physics parameters fluctuate over time, contributing to unpredictability.

dependencies: CharacterBody3D (the node this script is attached to)
verdict: The world itself weeps with Lyra's fading self, turning every step into a desperate dance against the physics of forgetting.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally transform player movement and environmental interaction, making the very ground beneath Lyra's feet a dynamic, unpredictable adversary. It directly translates her internal struggle with identity loss into a tangible, moment-to-moment physical threat, forcing players into constant, high-stakes adaptation against the unraveling physics of the memory-world. Every action becomes a desperate gamble, deepening the core theme of self-loss through visceral gameplay.
